entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I hope I can still do that.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it works fine. It's just... it's not what I expected. I feel really bad about this, I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while and I saved up for this, but I honestly just need the money back for another expense that came up.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account to check the purchase date. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's 772-B-9014. I was just so worried it would be too late. I know with things you wear, there are often strict rules about hygiene and all that.
Thank you. Let me check the return policy for you... Okay, I see you received it 37 days ago.
I know, I know. I figured that was a long time, especially with sanitation concerns. I just... I was hoping for an exception.
Actually, there's no need for an exception. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within the window, so I can definitely process this for you.
Wait, really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so convinced that it was too late and I was just stuck with it. That is such a relief.

Not at all. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3 to 5 business days.
That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Alex. You've really taken a weight off my shoulders.
I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
